title: Puzzle Explorer
shareTitle: Puzzle Explorer 🧩 — A Papercraft World Tour
description: Explore all seven continents through 21 papercraft animal, location, and cultural heritage puzzles, including a harder 12-piece challenge on every continent.
learningGoals: Strengthen visual-spatial reasoning by relating each part to a whole picture
Notice contours, colors, and neighboring image clues while finding a piece’s location
Practice purposeful dragging, tap-to-place, keyboard choice, and fine-motor control
interactionModel: choose a continent, then assemble any six-piece scene or twelve-piece challenge in any order by dragging pieces to their exact spaces, or tapping a piece and its matching space
feedbackModel: Correct pieces snap to the cutter’s exact reconstruction coordinates and remain on the board; misses return gently with no penalty, and the lightbulb models the matching path.

modes.title: Seven-Continent World Tour
modes.skill: explore 21 animal, location, and cultural heritage scenes

modes.title: Six-Piece Explorations
modes.skill: assemble the first two scenes in each continent

modes.title: Twelve-Piece Challenges
modes.skill: take on the harder final scene in each continent
